environment.description: Kubernetes cluster running the session-decrypt service as a standalone pod in the 'backend' namespace. Istio sidecar is injected but no AuthorizationPolicy resources are applied. The service is exposed via a ClusterIP service accessible from any pod in the cluster. An attacker with access to any pod in any namespace can reach /internal/decrypt and perform a padding oracle attack by observing the difference between HTTP 200 (valid padding) and HTTP 422 (invalid padding) responses.
